subject: FinArc security acceptance & retention: MAP and DPA next steps
messages:
From: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@finarc.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@finarc.com
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinArc security acceptance & retention: MAP and DPA next steps

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — overall really positive. The procurement and security teams asked me to capture the acceptance criteria so we can map to our procurement timeline. High level asks from FinArc: SOC 2 Type II evidence, completed SIG/CAIQ responses, signed DPA with clear data retention and deletion rules for both transactional and archival backups, and a list of all subprocessors.

Specifics FinArc would like to lock into the MAP:
- SOC 2: evidence for last 12 months, plus attestation PDF.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed XLS with any partial responses flagged and notes for planned remediation windows.
- DPA: we will redline your standard DPA — primary ask is retention windows by data type plus a defined deletion process for terminated accounts. Our legal team expects a turnaround within 10 business days after receiving a redline.
- Retention: for transaction logs and PII used for billing/chargebacks we require a 7-year retention window; for product telemetry we prefer 1 year rolling.
- Audit: access to audit logs for the previous 90 days is required for our security review; longer access can be part of SLA add-on.

Can you propose a mutually agreeable MAP with milestones and dates (acceptance gate definitions) so we can align procurement and legal? We are targeting contract signature by 2027-09-30 to meet quarter close.

Attachments: SOC2-attestation-2024.pdf (attestation), SIG-questionnaire-partial.xlsx (current state)

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Chen
Senior Security Program Manager, FinArc
elaine.chen@finarc.com
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@finarc.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinArc security acceptance & retention: MAP and DPA next steps

Elaine — thanks for the clear list, this is very helpful.

We can commit to a MAP that aligns with your timeline. Proposed milestones (high level):
1) MAP kickoff & evidence intake — 2027-09-07: collect SOC2 attestation, SIG gaps, subprocessor list.
2) Evidence validation & remediation plan — 2027-09-14: Redwood provides any follow-up evidence and a remediation window for outstanding SIG items.
3) DPA redline exchange — 2027-09-16: Redwood receives FinArc redline; we aim to return a final version within 7 business days for most commercial terms.
4) Final acceptance review & audit snapshot — 2027-09-23: FinArc security to confirm acceptance criteria met.
5) Signature & onboarding prep — 2027-09-29: Legal/Procurement sign, onboarding scheduled.

Acceptance gate definitions (draft):
- SOC2 gate: receipt of signed attestation and relevant control evidence for controls in scope; any open items must be classified with planned remediation dates.
- SIG gate: all must be answered; where answers are partial, we will annotate with mitigation controls and remediation timeline.
- DPA gate: agreement on retention by data type plus a mutually accepted deletion API/workflow for terminated accounts.

On retention specifics: we can support a 7-year retention window for billing/transactional PII in a contractual addendum. Product telemetry default retention is 12 months, but we can offer a longer retention tier for audit purposes — we will include estimated cost delta in the MAP.

I attached the DPA redline template (Proposed-DPA-redline.docx) for your legal team to mark up. Also adding links to our audit snapshot process.

Next steps: please confirm the milestone dates above or propose adjustments. If those dates work, I will schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff for Wed 2027-09-07 and loop in our compliance lead (Marissa).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: Proposed-DPA-redline.docx
From: Tom Berger <tom.berger@finarc.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@finarc.com>, legal@finarc.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinArc security acceptance & retention: MAP and DPA next steps

Jonas / Elaine — quick clarifying questions before the kickoff so legal can prep: 

1) For the 7-year billing/transaction retention, will Redwood retain backups beyond that window by default? We'd like explicit confirmation of how backups are handled and a contractual deletion procedure.
2) Encryption: can you confirm that both in-transit and at-rest encryption are enabled by default, and whether customer-managed keys (KMS) are available for Private/Dedicated plans?
3) Subprocessors: please provide the current subprocessor list and expected onboarding notice period for new subprocessors.

Also — for the SIG spreadsheet, can you flag which answers are 'in-scope' for our SOC2 assessment versus your longer-term roadmap items? That will help prioritize our review.

Thanks,
Tom Berger
Head of IT Risk, FinArc
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Berger <tom.berger@finarc.com>, Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@finarc.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinArc security acceptance & retention: MAP and DPA next steps

Tom / Elaine — appreciate the questions. Answers below and updated MAP milestones.

1) Backups & deletion: Redwood retains primary data and backups in separate retention tiers. We will contractually guarantee deletion of primary data at the agreed retention window; backups that intersect the deletion window are scheduled for purging within 30 days of the primary deletion event unless otherwise stated in the DPA. We will add specific language in the DPA (Section 4.2) for backup purge timing and verification.

2) Encryption: yes — TLS 1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest by default. For Dedicated and Private customers we support customer-managed keys (KMS) with HSM options; for hosted customers we offer standard managed keys. We'll include the KMS configuration options in the evidence bundle.

3) Subprocessors: attached is the current list and our subprocessors policy. Redwood provides 30 days' notice for non-critical subprocessors and 60 days for any that process sensitive PII. We will provide an exportable CSV as part of the evidence intake.

Updated MAP milestones (confirmed):
- 2027-09-07: MAP kickoff & evidence intake (SOC2 attestation, SIG partial answers flagged, subprocessor CSV) — scheduled 09:30 PT.
- 2027-09-13: Redwood evidence package delivered (controls mapping, KMS options, backup purge process).
- 2027-09-19: FinArc security review complete; list of any critical open items.
- 2027-09-23: Final acceptance call.
- 2027-09-29: Final contract signature (target).

We will upload the evidence to the shared Drive link and send a DocuSign packet for the DPA redline after your legal marks it up. HubSpot deal DA-8791 will be updated with MAP milestones and acceptance checkboxes.
